Read WorldClim 2.1 at 30 arc-seconds for a region only

Source: R/worldclim.R
worldclim_region.Rd

Reads the 30 arc-second (about 1 km) WorldClim 2.1 normals (1970-2000) for a region without downloading global or country files. The 30x30 degree tiles published by WorldClim are opened remotely with GDAL's /vsicurl/ driver and only the strips that intersect the region are transferred via HTTP range requests (for a 20 x 20 km window, a few hundred kilobytes per variable instead of a 40 MB country file or a 450 MB global archive). Regions spanning several tiles are read tile by tile and merged.

Usage

worldclim_region(
  var = c("tmin", "tmax", "tavg", "prec", "srad", "wind", "bio", "elev"),
  region,
  path,
  mask = TRUE,
  touches = TRUE,
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

var

One of "tmin", "tmax", "tavg", "prec", "srad", "wind", "bio" or "elev".

region

A SpatExtent, a numeric vector c(xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax) in longitude/latitude, or a SpatVector (any CRS; polygons can be used as a mask).

path

Cache directory.

mask

If TRUE and region is a polygon SpatVector, mask cells outside the polygons.

touches

Passed to terra::mask(): keep cells touched by the polygon boundary.

overwrite

Ignore and replace a cached file.

Value

A SpatRaster in EPSG:4326 at 30 arc-seconds. Monthly variables have 12 layers named m01 to m12; bio has 19 layers (bio01 to bio19) and elev one layer. Attribute "source" lists the remote tiles read.

Details

When region is a polygon SpatVector and mask = TRUE, cells outside the polygons are set to NA (cells touched by the boundary are kept when touches = TRUE). The result is cached in path; a later call with the same region, variable and mask reuses the cached file without network access.

This is the WorldClim 2.1 equivalent of the regional 30 arc-second download that raster::getData("worldclim", res = 0.5, lon, lat) offered for WorldClim 1.4. Coarser resolutions (2.5, 5 and 10 arc-minutes) are only distributed as compressed global archives, which cannot be read partially; use worldclim_monthly() for them. Aggregating the 30 arc-second data is not a substitute: in tests over central Chile the official 2.5 arc-minute product differed from the 5 x 5 cell mean of the 30 arc-second product by up to about 0.9 degrees C.

References

Fick, S. E., & Hijmans, R. J. (2017). WorldClim 2: new 1-km spatial resolution climate surfaces for global land areas. International Journal of Climatology, 37(12), 4302-4315.

See also

worldclim_monthly(), study_window(), check_monthly_climate().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
win <- study_window(-72.3225, -35.9671, size_km = 20)
tmin <- worldclim_region("tmin", win, path = "data")

# Mask with a polygon (for example a commune boundary)
# comuna <- terra::vect("cauquenes.gpkg")
# tmax <- worldclim_region("tmax", comuna, path = "data", mask = TRUE)
} # }
